cards.headline: XI, TRUMP & PUTIN MEET IN SHENZHEN
cards.detail: APEC summit: Xi pledges open trade and a $20M fund; Trump pushes a three-way nuclear deal and rejects global AI rules. The three leaders issue a joint peace declaration, silent on Ukraine and Iran.

cards.headline: GTA VI LAUNCHES WORLDWIDE
cards.detail: After a 13-year wait the game rolls out from New Zealand at midnight; reviews average 99/100, 2.3M watch on Twitch.

cards.headline: ISRAELI TANKS CROSS GAZA CEASEFIRE LINE
cards.detail: IDF ground operation in Nuseirat ends Thursday after a day; at least four more people are killed across Gaza on Thursday.

cards.headline: CRIMEAN BRIDGE ATTACKED AGAIN
cards.detail: Traffic halted after a third hit on the bridge this week, Crimea's Russian-installed chief says.

cards.headline: CYCLONE AKVAN NEARS INDIA'S EAST COAST
cards.detail: Landfall expected between Machilipatnam and Puri; Odisha shuts schools as the storm closes in.

cards.headline: DOW FALLS 561 AS FED TURNS HAWKISH
cards.detail: Fed minutes flag more rate hikes; the dollar hits a 19-month high while gold, silver and oil slide.

cards.headline: VAN GOGH SELLS FOR A RECORD $190.4M
cards.detail: The sale follows a public row over the painting's Nazi-era history.

cards.headline: VOYAGER 1 REACHES A 'LIGHT-DAY'
cards.detail: NASA's farthest probe is now so distant that its radio signal takes a full day to reach Earth.

cards.headline: WORLD COURT: MYANMAR COMMITTED GENOCIDE
cards.detail: ICJ rules 9–6 that the 2017 crackdown on the Rohingya was genocide — the first time the court has held a state guilty; orders return home and compensation.

cards.headline: ROCKET STRIKE KILLS 53 SOLDIERS IN YEMEN
cards.detail: Houthi attack on an army camp; Saudi air alerts were raised over Riyadh, then lifted.

cards.headline: EISENKOT ASKED TO FORM ISRAEL'S GOVERNMENT
cards.detail: The president taps Gadi Eisenkot as prime minister-designate, bypassing Benjamin Netanyahu.

cards.headline: ANTHROPIC'S RECORD $81.3BN IPO DEBUTS
cards.detail: Claude maker lists on Nasdaq as ANT at $83; shares open at $111.50 and close up 17% — the biggest IPO ever.
